title: 17 December 2009: Paul McCartney live at Köln Arena, Cologne
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Kölnarena in Cologne, Germany, on 17 December 2009.

It was the sixth show of the Good Evening Europe Tour, which lasted for eight dates in December 2009, and the second of two consecutive nights in Cologne.

McCartney had previously performed at the Kölnarena during the Back In The World Tour on 27 and 28 April 2003. He returned on 1 December 2011 for the On The Run Tour.

The setlist was the same as the previous night’s concert in the city.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
